facebook.caption:
POV: you took a wrong street in Khu 1 and ended up here.

Dinh Bà Thủy Long Thánh Mẫu sits on Võ Thị Sáu and most tourists walk straight past it. 4.5 stars across 287 reviews from people who actually stopped.

Red lanterns, incense smoke, total quiet. Two minutes from the tourist strip and it feels like a different island.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
